section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of the study, primarily focusing on the use of self-report measures, which are prone to memory bias and recall issues. It also highlights the difficulty in discerning thoughtful responses from random selections, despite efforts to remove questionable answers based on response time. The section recommends future longitudinal studies to minimize personal bias.
